body: Schedule analysis for January to October 2026 shows that four airports stopped seeing Allegiant Air aircraft: Los Angeles International Airport (LAX), which last saw the airline in January 2026; Columbia Metropolitan Airport, Oakland San Francisco Bay Airport (OAK) and Palm Springs International Airport, all in May 2026. Three of the four are in California, following the removal of flights to San Diego in September 2025.

Los Angeles was Allegiant's longest-serving of the four markets: the carrier arrived at LAX on May 1, 2009, operated 42 routes there over 17 years, and carried a total of 5.8 million passengers to and from the airport between 2009 and 2026, according to U.S. Department of Transportation data. Columbia returned to the network in May 2025 after a 16-year absence but was dropped 12 months later, with only 47.3 percent of seats filled.

With the four exits, Allegiant now serves six places in California: Burbank, Fresno, Monterey, Orange County, Santa Maria and Stockton. The Los Angeles basin remains served through Burbank and Orange County, while San Francisco Bay has been removed from the airline's map. Between November 2026 and next May, Cirium Diio data shows the carrier's aircraft will appear at 123 airports across the United States.
en.summary: Allegiant Air stopped serving four airports in 2026, including Los Angeles after 17 years, leaving six California destinations on its map.
en.title: Allegiant Air ends service to four destinations in 2026, including Los Angeles after 17 years

body: 2026年1月至10月的班表分析顯示，忠實航空已停止飛往4座機場：洛杉磯國際機場（LAX）於2026年1月最後出現忠實航空班機，哥倫比亞大都會機場、奧克蘭舊金山灣機場與棕櫚泉國際機場則於2026年5月退出。其中3座位於加州，此前忠實航空已於2025年9月撤出聖地牙哥。
洛杉磯是4座機場中忠實航空經營最久的市場：該公司於2009年5月1日進駐洛杉磯國際機場，17年間共經營42條航線，依美國運輸部資料，2009年至2026年間共載運580萬人次往返該機場。哥倫比亞則於2025年5月暌違16年重返航網，但12個月後即退出，載客率僅47.3%。
退出4座機場後，忠實航空在加州僅剩6個航點：柏班克、佛雷斯諾、蒙特瑞、橙縣、聖瑪麗亞與史塔克頓；洛杉磯盆地仍可經由柏班克與橙縣服務，舊金山灣區則已自航網移除。依Cirium Diio資料，2026年11月至明年5月間，該公司飛機將出現在全美123座機場。
zh.summary: 忠實航空2026年退出4座機場，包括經營17年的洛杉磯，加州航點僅剩6處。
zh.title: 忠實航空2026年退出4座機場，洛杉磯17年航線劃下句點
